review_evidence: README identifies the repository as a template for calling Rust functions in Lean through the C FFI.
A complete scan of its two Lean files found four declaration-style lines and no theorem, lemma, axiom, or proposition-example declarations.

Main.lean only declares an external addFromRust function and prints addFromRust 1 2; the other Lean file is build configuration. There is no formal Rust semantics, FFI specification, or correctness proof.

source_action.content_invariant: Its Lean content is only a minimal external-function demonstration and build configuration, with no propositions or formal semantics/specification. Retirement removes no mathematical or formal-methods prior art sought by the corpus.
